metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to decompress your lower back in bed with the 'backhammer' exercise.

This will focus on using bodyweight and gravity to help open the lower back through a pulling motion known as traction.

It's great for quickly taking pressure off lumbar spinal joints, and may give lower back pain and sciatica relief within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
